question: With exactly the same prior facts, public observations, and action opportunities, does a persistent tokenless structured concept/relationship memory enable faster discovery and consequential action under unfamiliar causal laws than unstructured memories, shuffled wiring, independent Bayesian/symbolic inference, and fully trained recurrent controls?
hypothesis: Relationship structure and experience-driven revision—not extra facts, hindsight outcome access, an oracle, or copying a known rule family—causally improve discovery, intervention choice, retention and disjoint unfamiliar-law transfer.

domain.task: SOURCE-PRIVATE SYNTHETIC INTERVENTION WORLDS WITH PHYSICAL SIMULATED ACTION CONSEQUENCES; NOT REAL-WORLD INTELLIGENCE PROOF
domain.public_interface: Eight observable uint4 registers [0..15], one public action index [0..7], a public scalar reward in [-1,1], public done flag, and up to 16 prior public transitions; no latent law identity, oracle, simulator state, source code, private debug or alternate future outcomes presented to learners

source_law_separation.foundation: Public factual records from separate foundation worlds with ordinary directed dependence, conditional co-occurrence and signed/delayed effects; NO target DEV/TRANSFER law instance or generator key
source_law_separation.training: Local single-step affine-mod16 and bounded pairwise monotone-mixing laws; no DEV/TRANSFER operator templates supplied to a learner
source_law_separation.validation: Disjoint parameter and graph draws from training families, used for model selection only
source_law_separation.development: Context-switched delayed parity-gated carry and inhibitory two-step coupling; withheld as a disjoint law-family first-use, not pre-enumerated to learner
source_law_separation.transfer: Disjoint world instances with independent mixtures of delayed switching and reversal under observable interventions; held untouched until separately qualified

domain.identifiability: Before scored first-use, a source-owner-only deterministic probe must verify that two law hypotheses inconsistent on relevant consequences can be distinguished by <=24 allowed public interventions; all 32 preset DEV worlds are reported, never filtered after scoring; inadequate headroom or indistinguishability yields SOURCE_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE rather than learner NO-GO
domain.source_contract: Implement and freeze a separate independent law generator, source digest, full semantics and redaction tests before any new original DEV or TRANSFER outcome; source-private branch/law code is evaluator-only, not importable by any model

equal_information_arms.STRUCTURED: Candidate tokenless bounded graph-like prior with explicit concept identity, directional conditional/delayed edges, bounded confidence, public intervention updates, compositional reads and reversible corrections
equal_information_arms.FLAT: Same exact 32,768 foundation records, observations, metadata and memory budget as STRUCTURED but no persistent relationship connectivity
equal_information_arms.SHUFFLED: Same facts and edge-count/degree histogram as STRUCTURED, deterministically permuted endpoints; keep equal capacity and public action data
equal_information_arms.MINIMAL: No large foundation, same action and observation budget; tests contribution of prior facts
equal_information_arms.NO_UPDATE: Same STRUCTURED initial prior and readout, freeze all relation updates after initialization
equal_information_arms.BAYES_SYMBOLIC: Independent competent factored Bayesian/symbolic causal structure learner; same full 32,768 public facts and action/observation tape, unrestricted rule hypotheses within matched capacity limits
equal_information_arms.RECURRENT: Fully trained recurrent sequence learner at least 24 complete epochs per seed for seeds 1515 and 2626, validation-only checkpoint selection, same complete public history and prior facts
equal_information_arms.COUNT_RETRIEVAL: Standard empirical conditional transition and nearest-neighbor controls with same public fact corpus, fit/selection only on train/validation

fairness.process_cost: Report source actions, initialization time, fit time/epochs, online update CPU and wall time, inference CPU and wall time, memory, checkpoints, and full trials; do not assert FLOP/time parity without measured receipts

frozen_metrics.primary: Mean 16-step actual collected reward per independent fresh DEV world; STRUCTURED minus the best non-oracle matched-information qualified control (including FLAT, SHUFFLED, BAYES_SYMBOLIC, RECURRENT, COUNT_RETRIEVAL), world-cluster paired bootstrap with 10,000 replicates and control reselected per replicate
frozen_metrics.compound_success: All DEV/TRANSFER thresholds AND cold retention and interference controls, no leakage, >=24 valid independent DEV worlds, real source headroom and complete scientifically independent replication; mere DEV advantage never SCIENTIFIC_PASS

stop_and_reporting.stop_on: Missing independent first-use owner; custody collision; source-label leakage; capacity/action information mismatch; unidentified action effects; absent strong fully trained controls; protocol or SHA drift; insufficient headroom; overbudget
stop_and_reporting.if_dev_is_positive: DEV_SIGNAL_ONLY; independent disjoint TRANSFER and separate owner/replication required
stop_and_reporting.after_result: Freeze all source/method/seeds/thresholds; preserve negative/null records; no retuning original consumed DEV
stop_and_reporting.integration: No merge or native Yggdrasil model admission absent independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS, exact-source full dual-platform engineering qualification, and separately verified project owner approval
stop_and_reporting.native_north_star: Distinct tokenless, non-transformer, non-next-token Yggdrasil substrate; no replacement by donor architecture
stop_and_reporting.source_and_science: Synthetic task success is narrow and must never be presented as general intelligence, goal competence outside this source, or improvements in native Yggdrasil

qualification_plan.source_safe_fixtures: Public-only input projection, no hidden-law leakage, action-before-reward seal, identical 24-step exploration, fact equality, shuffled-degree matching, negative/cold/contradiction tests, model-capacity rejection, source seed guards and no DEV open in fixture
qualification_plan.before_first_use: Exact frozen science-source SHA/tree, source independent owner, precommitted source ID and disjoint seed/custody verification, all focused and complete inherited 54/54 final regression on Ubuntu24.04 and Windows2022, G29/atlas, clean tree
qualification_plan.original_dev: Exactly once after scoped owner permission; 32 original worlds, all arms and action receipts, saved unredacted immutable artifact and durable succinct signed report
qualification_plan.after_dev: Postsource exact SHA full regression, deterministic consumed public replay, independent validation/replication only if original outcome eligible
qualification_plan.protected_transfer: Remains closed without separately verified owner approval
